networkAccess.exposedWithHost: Exposed on all interfaces. Pairing links use {{host}}.
networkAccess.cannotViewOrChange: This connection cannot view or change network exposure.
networkAccess.remoteAlreadyConfigured: Remote access is already configured. Change network exposure where the server starts.
networkAccess.onlyThisMachineCanConnect: Only this machine can connect. Restart with a non-loopback host for remote pairing.
networkAccess.remoteControlledTooltip: Network exposure changes restart the backend and must be controlled where the server process is launched.
networkAccess.enableDescription: Let your other devices connect to T3 Code over the network. Pair devices to give them access. T3 Code will restart.
networkAccess.disableDescription: Devices connected over your local network will disconnect. Existing tunnels, such as T3 Connect or Tailscale HTTPS, keep working. T3 Code will restart.

tailscale.useServeDescription: Use Tailscale Serve to expose this backend through a MagicDNS HTTPS URL.
tailscale.setupDescription: T3 Code will restart the local backend with Tailscale Serve enabled and ask Tailscale to proxy HTTPS traffic to this backend.
tailscale.disableDescription: T3 Code will restart the local backend without Tailscale Serve.
tailscale.couldNotSetUp: Could not set up Tailscale HTTPS

wsl.loadFailedDescription: Couldn't load the WSL backend state.
wsl.unavailableDescription: WSL is unavailable, so Windows is running instead. Turn WSL off to clear this preference.
wsl.runAlongsideDescription: Run the selected WSL distro alongside Windows. Projects remain on their current filesystem.
wsl.onlyDescription: Run only the WSL backend. T3 Code restarts when this changes.

dialog.turnOffAndSwitchTitle: Turn off WSL and switch back to Windows?
dialog.disableWasOnlyDescription: T3 Code will restart on the Windows backend. Threads and projects opened against WSL stay safe inside the distro and become available again when you re-enable WSL.
dialog.disableDescription: The WSL backend will stop. Threads and projects opened against WSL stay safe inside the distro, but they'll be unavailable in T3 Code until you re-enable WSL.
dialog.switchDistroDescription: T3 Code will restart the WSL backend on the new distro. Sessions still running on the current distro will be interrupted.
dialog.startDescription: Run the WSL backend alongside the Windows one, or stop the Windows backend and use only WSL? You can change this later from Settings.
dialog.onlyDescription: T3 Code will restart and start only the WSL backend. Your Windows-side projects won't be accessible until you turn this off again.
dialog.reEnableWindowsDescription: T3 Code will restart and bring the Windows backend back up alongside WSL.

authorizedClients.title: Authorized clients
authorizedClients.cannotView: This connection can create access links but cannot view authorized clients.

access.revokeOtherClientsDescription: Other paired clients will need a new pairing link before reconnecting.

backends.failedSwitchOn: Failed to switch the backend on.
backends.failedSwitchOff: Failed to switch the backend off.

environments.title: Environments
environments.connectToView: Connect an environment to view its settings and access.
